name: Waning Quoin
description: Chalk the aim point on the face of a timber barricade and lay the bore on it.

name: Mightshot
description: Wheel the heavy ball to the muzzle on a barrow and lift it into the bore with a rope sling.

name: Quoinelixir
description: Count out the heavy charge by scoops and bag it so the cartridge is neither short nor loose.

name: Verity Wheelhub
description: Tap each trunnion cap with a mallet and listen for a loose pin before a heavy round is fired.

name: Unbroken Carriage
description: Set a padded beam behind the trail and lean the crew against it to hold the gun in place.

name: Equipoise Touchhole
description: Press qi through the rammer into the wad so the heavy ball is seated tight with no gap.

name: Raging Broadside
description: Fire a heavy ball with a qi-hardened core into a timber barricade so it punches clean through the planks.

name: Successive Hour Trunnion
description: Fire three heavy balls at one spot on a barricade so each wedges into the hole the last one left.

name: Sharp Breechrope
description: Drive a row of marker stakes across the field to show each gun where its walked step of fire lies.

name: Anointing Linstock
description: Slap the thigh at a steady beat so every gun on the line fires on the same count.

name: Hastening Muzzleswell
description: Pace out the gap between guns so wheels do not foul and smoke does not blind the next crew.

name: Granite Gunbore
description: Spread a waxed cloth over the cartridge box so a sudden shower cannot soak the powder.

name: Might Breechrope
description: Pass spare handspikes along the line so a broken one never holds a gun still.

name: Shade Bombard
description: Fire each gun in turn down the line so the field is never free of falling shot.

name: Nova Roar
description: Raise each following round by half a notch so the fall of shot marches steadily toward the enemy.

name: Shotremedy
description: Rouse a rested gun into the line as a hot one falls silent so the barrage keeps its rhythm.

name: Shotthrash
description: Walk a curtain of fused shells forward by short fuse steps so the burst line moves ahead of the attackers.

name: Lotrecoil
description: Lift every gun to the far line on one call as attackers close the near trench so shot passes over them.

name: Cascabel Canter
description: Walk the line and nudge each wheel with a toe until every axle lies on one level line.

name: Rejuvenating Muzzleswell
description: Count the cartridge boxes in the powder dump against the rounds each gun is meant to fire.

name: Vigorous Trunnion
description: Pull the signal cord from the centre so each end gun hears the same call at the same moment.

name: Daybreak Cascabel
description: Sweep dry grass from the gun floor so sparks cannot start a fire among the crews.

name: Quoinlinctus
description: Spread the field of qi across the line so each crew breathes in step and loads on the same count.

name: Waning Wheelhub
description: Read the drift of massed smoke across the line to learn which guns are blinded and which can see.

name: Bounding Gunbore
description: Step the whole battery back a pace as one body so overlapping recoil never tangles the wheels.

name: Cannonade Assault
description: Gather the crews through a slow count and fire every gun in one crash so all the shot lands together.

name: Sinister Quoin
description: Rotate half the battery behind the other half in a set pattern so one line fires while the other reloads.

name: Verityshot
description: Mark the bearing of an enemy muzzle flash along a raised arm and a stake line.

name: Discerning Carriage
description: Count the breaths between flash and sound to judge how far away the enemy gun stands.

name: Waning Linstock
description: Judge the size of an enemy battery by how many smoke plumes rise and how thick they stand.

name: Verityquoin
description: Rest the spyglass on a wheel rim and hold the breath to read the enemy gun crew.

name: Vital Trunnion
description: Chalk the bearing on a slate and hand it to a runner for the next gun in line.

name: Vitalquoin
description: Set the quoin to the first estimate of range and call the number aloud to the crew.

name: Verity Linstock
description: Take bearings from two guns set apart and mark where the lines cross to fix the enemy gun.

name: Facet Recoil
description: Fire back along the fixed bearing at once so the enemy's second shot is spoiled.

name: Cannonthrash
description: Aim a heavy ball low at the enemy gun's carriage to split a wheel or an axle.

name: Mayhem Recoil
description: Hold one gun silent and shift it to a new site while the rest keep firing so the enemy aims at the old place.

name: Intent Ballshot
description: Mass the guns on a fixed enemy battery for a long count so its crews dare not reload.

name: Compounding Touchhole
description: Fire one round then roll the gun to a prepared second site before the enemy's answer arrives.

name: Rejuvenating Gunbore
description: Two crewmen grip one rammer staff together and drive it home in a single matched stroke.

name: Torrent Cannonade
description: Stand opposite a partner across the barrel and step in unison so neither blocks the other.

name: Vital Muzzleswell
description: Lock the handspikes beneath the trail with a partner and swing the gun round on a shared count.

name: Intent Touchhole
description: Alternate water buckets with a partner so one sponge is always wet while the other is filled.

name: Cannongreave
description: Step in front of a partner who is loading and take the knock of a glancing splinter.

name: Mindful Carriage
description: Breathe in step with the gunner while he lays and call the notch when he nods.

name: Might Wheelhub
description: Run sponge and rammer in a matched cycle so the bore is dried, loaded and clear in a single beat.

name: Rumblecannon
description: Cross two portfires over the vent at once so the discharge never fails on a damp morning.

name: Gust Broadside
description: Two crewmen swing the trail in a mirrored arc to pivot the gun and drive off a flank rush.

name: Hour Ballshot
description: Fire, sponge, reload and fire again before the first smoke clears, two crews working as one gun.

name: Roartorment
description: One crew fires while its pair reloads in turn so a steady stream of shot pins the enemy line.

name: Cannonelixir
description: Drop the gaze from the horizon to the mark in a single stoop to catch its range.

name: Chime Cascabel
description: Climb a mound or wagon bed to read the ground between gun and foe from above.

name: Keen Linstock
description: Judge the hour by the length of the gun's shadow so the sun is placed behind the crew.

name: Intentshot
description: Hold the body perfectly still at the trail for a count of ten to remove tremor from the lay.

name: Gunbore Elixir
description: Read how a river bend or ford will slow the enemy column and lay upon that choke point.

name: Intent Breechrope
description: Correct the lay for a wind quartering from behind so the ball does not drift off the line.

name: Blaze Recoil
description: Hold the breath and the sight on a distant mark through three heartbeats before loosing the ball.

name: Quoinassault
description: Follow a moving column with the muzzle and fire as its lead rank crosses a marked ford.

name: Equipoise Cascabel
description: Breathe qi down one track into the arms and steady the body along the other before touching the gun.

name: Daybreak Quoin
description: Press a thin film of qi onto the iron ball with both palms before it is loaded.

name: Remnant Quoin
description: Run a thread of qi along the bore to sense any crack or scale inside the iron.

name: Keen Trunnion
description: Look at the glint of the touch-hole to read whether the iron is cool enough to fire.

name: Intent Carriage
description: Pulse qi into the cartridge at breech and muzzle in two beats so powder and shot seat in one motion.

name: Breechrope Remedy
description: Extend a thin thread of qi from the muzzle to the mark and lay the bore along it.

name: Quoinplating
description: Spread a ring of qi outward from the carriage wheels to take the gun's recoil into the ground.

name: Facet Cannonade
description: Sheathe the ball in qi and fire, keeping a thread of will on it so its flight stays true.

name: Facet Ballshot
description: Send two threads of qi along the ball's path so it punches through a layered barricade without stalling.
